title: 车里很静
summary: Night, much later the same evening: the back of the moving car. She sits with her cardboard box on her knees, and the woman introduced as 陆总 has been sitting one place away from her since the car left the tower.
shots:
Entry state, new location, much later that night, taken from the reference image: the rear cabin of the moving black sedan seen from the front seats looking back — a wide pale-grey leather rear bench with a central armrest, warm amber courtesy lights along the roof lining, tinted windows with bright city bokeh sliding past outside. 苏小满 (S1) sits in the RIGHT rear seat with the cardboard box upright on her knees; 陆蔓 (S8) sits in the LEFT rear seat, one empty place between them, and has been in the car since it left the tower. 陆蔓 (S8) is a composed woman of fifty in a deep-green jacquard silk qipao.
[Shot 1] Wide from the front: the car running through the city at night in warm amber light, the city sliding past the tinted glass, her cardboard box standing on her knees, her hands flat on top of it, the seat beside her occupied by a still, composed woman who has not looked at her once.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, 陆蔓 (S8) shifts slightly on the LEFT rear seat and settles back against the leather, one empty place between them; 苏小满 (S1) turns her head just enough to look at her without turning her shoulders.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, closer on 陆蔓 (S8): she does not look back; she keeps her eyes on the window for a moment longer, entirely at ease, one hand resting on the armrest.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, the driver's eyes flick up in the rear-view mirror and away. Nobody speaks in this beat and the engine is the only sound.
soundscape: Quiet expensive cabin: tyre roar on asphalt, a faint air-conditioning draft, the indicator ticking once, distant city outside the glass.
music: A low warm string bed, unhurried.

title: 像。也不像
summary: The woman beside her opens with two words that are clearly a comparison, and refuses to be asked who she is.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) sits in the RIGHT rear seat with the cardboard box on her knees; 陆蔓 (S8) sits in the LEFT rear seat, one empty place between them; the car is moving, city lights sliding across the tinted glass.
[Shot 1] Medium two-shot across the empty middle seat: 陆蔓 (S8) turns her head at last and looks at her properly, from the hair down to the box on her knees, and speaks in a low amused unhurried Mandarin, as if thinking out loud: [Chinese] 像。也不像。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, close on 苏小满 (S1): she does not ask what that means; she asks the direct question instead, in her low flat Mandarin: [Chinese] 您是谁。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, closer on 陆蔓 (S8), who does not answer it; the corner of her mouth moves, which is not quite a smile.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.200, hold on the two of them facing each other across the empty seat. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: The cabin's low road hum, a low female voice, her own flat question, low city traffic through the glass, the indicator ticking off.
music: A low piano note under the exchange.

title: 人到了，你不见
summary: She answers the question with a question of her own, and demonstrates that she already knows exactly what happened yesterday.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 陆蔓 (S8) sits in the LEFT rear seat of the moving car facing 苏小满 (S1), who is in the RIGHT rear seat with the box on her knees; warm amber cabin light; city sliding past outside.
[Shot 1] Medium: 陆蔓 (S8) settles back against the pale leather as she speaks, watching her the whole time, in the same low amused Mandarin, letting the facts do the work: [Chinese] 小罗说，你昨天打了个电话。人到了，你不见。
[Shot 2] At 00:08.200, close on 苏小满 (S1): she keeps her eyes forward and does not help her.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.200, tight on 陆蔓's (S8) face, waiting.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold. She does not speak again in this beat and neither does 苏小满 (S1).
soundscape: One low amused voice over tyre noise, the box creaking faintly against her knees, the cabin's air conditioning, a horn far away.

title: 实在
summary: Three short lines: she is asked why she came tonight, she gives one flat reason, and the woman beside her approves of it.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 陆蔓 (S8) sits in the LEFT rear seat of the moving car, 苏小满 (S1) in the RIGHT rear seat with the cardboard box on her knees, one empty place between them.
[Shot 1] Medium: 陆蔓 (S8) turns slightly in her seat so that she is squarely facing her, and asks it in the same low unhurried Mandarin: [Chinese] 今天，怎么肯来了。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, close on 苏小满 (S1): she does not dress it up; she answers in her flat low Mandarin with three syllables: [Chinese] 工作没了。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, closer on 陆蔓 (S8): a real, brief, approving smile crosses her face and she says it in a lighter, warmer Mandarin: [Chinese] 实在。
[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, wide two-shot across the empty seat, both of them looking forward now as the car runs through the city lights. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A low question, three flat syllables, a short warm laugh underneath the approval, tyre noise and low street traffic.
music: A light low piano phrase under the approval.

title: 把绳子摘下来
summary: She asks for the cord around the girl's neck, and is refused.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) sits in the RIGHT rear seat of the moving car with the cardboard box on her knees, the thin red cord at her collar; 陆蔓 (S8) sits in the LEFT rear seat, one empty place between them.
[Shot 1] Medium: 陆蔓 (S8) lifts her chin toward the other woman's throat and asks it in the same low unhurried Mandarin, with the polite form of a request rather than an order: [Chinese] 脖子上那根绳，摘下来，我看看。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.600, close on 苏小满 (S1): she does not even think about it; she lifts her free hand and presses it flat over the collar of her shirt, covering the cord, and answers in her low flat Mandarin: [Chinese] 我妈给的。不摘。
[Shot 3] At 00:09.200, closer on 陆蔓 (S8): two fingers of amusement, no offence taken at all.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on the two of them across the empty seat. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: One low courteous request, cloth rustling as a hand covers a collar, one flat refusal, city traffic through tinted glass.
music: A single low sustained note under the refusal.

title: 它有用
summary: Four words of approval with something much less friendly underneath them.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) sits in the RIGHT rear seat of the moving car with her hand still flat over her collar covering the red cord; 陆蔓 (S8) is in the LEFT rear seat, one empty place between them.
[Shot 1] Medium: 陆蔓 (S8) looks at the hand over the collar for a beat before she answers, in a low smiling Mandarin, warm on the surface: [Chinese] 不摘好。它有用。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.400, close on 苏小满 (S1): her eyes come up and settle on the other woman's face; she has heard the second half of that sentence for what it is.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.400, tighter on 陆蔓 (S8), smiling, entirely comfortable, one finger tapping once on the armrest.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.400, hold on 苏小满's (S1) face. She says nothing in this beat and neither does anyone else.
soundscape: A low warm voice with something cold in it, one finger tapping leather, tyre noise, a distant siren dying away outside.
music: A single uneasy high note appearing over the low bed.

title: 到了，你就知道
summary: She asks the direct question again and is told to wait.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 陆蔓 (S8) sits in the LEFT rear seat of the moving car, 苏小满 (S1) in the RIGHT rear seat with the cardboard box on her knees and the red cord at her collar; one empty place between them.
[Shot 1] Medium: 苏小满 (S1) turns her head to face her squarely for the first time and asks it in her low even Mandarin, holding the other woman's eyes: [Chinese] 你们找我，到底要干什么。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.600, closer on 陆蔓 (S8): she answers it without hesitating and without answering it, in the same low amused Mandarin: [Chinese] 到了，你就知道。
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, wide two-shot: the car turns and the city lights sweep across both their faces at once.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on 苏小满 (S1). Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: One quiet direct question, one smooth non-answer, tyres on a turn, the indicator ticking, distant city.

title: 底细都翻过了
summary: Her phone buzzes; she answers it low, and the one line she says is a report on the girl sitting beside her.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) sits in the RIGHT rear seat of the moving car; 陆蔓 (S8) in the LEFT rear seat, one empty place between them; the cabin in warm amber light.
[Shot 1] Close on the armrest between them: 陆蔓's (S8) phone lights up and buzzes twice against the leather.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, 陆蔓 (S8) picks it up, turns her shoulder slightly away and answers it with her voice pitched down, in a low quiet Mandarin — the change of register is the point: [Chinese] 嗯。到了。……底细都翻过了。干净。
[Shot 3] At 00:08.600, insert: 苏小满's (S1) ear, the only part of her that moves; her head stays perfectly forward and her face gives nothing.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.600, hold on 陆蔓 (S8) putting the phone back down on the armrest, screen dark. Nobody else speaks.
soundscape: A phone buzzing on leather, a low pitched-down voice close to a microphone, the cabin's air conditioning, city traffic far outside.
music: A low uneasy string note under the word clean.

title: 朱漆大门
summary: Silent beat: the car turns into an old alley and stops at the far end, in front of a tall vermilion gate.
shots:
Entry state, taken from the reference images: the moving car interior with 苏小满 (S1) in the RIGHT rear seat and 陆蔓 (S8) in the LEFT rear seat; outside, the night alley with the vermilion lacquered double gate at its far end.
[Shot 1] From outside, wide: the black sedan turns off a lit main road into a narrow old brick alley; the main-road hum thins out behind them on the cut.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, tracking with the car down the alley: mossy brick walls on both sides, a warm paper lantern glowing at the far end above the tall vermilion gate, the gate itself with its brass studs and stone drums.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, through the rear windscreen, close on 苏小满's (S1) face as she sees it, her cardboard box still upright on her knees.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.600, from outside: the car stops at the foot of the gate; 小罗 (S7) and two of the suited men are already standing in the alley ahead of it, waiting; a driver's door opens and footsteps come round the back.
[Shot 5] At 00:09.000, the rear door is opened for her; 苏小满 (S1) ducks her head and steps out onto the stone paving with the cardboard box in her arms, while 陆蔓 (S8) stays exactly where she is on the LEFT rear seat and does not get out. Nobody speaks in this beat.
soundscape: Tyres on cobbles, the engine note dropping to idle, the main road hum thinning out behind them, an engine ticking as it stops, one car door opening.
music: A low horn note under the turn, the theme underneath it.

title: 能签字就行
summary: She stands in front of the gate with her box and hears, through the gap in the doors, a voice inside talking about her as a signature.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: outside at night, 苏小满 (S1) has just got out of the car and stands on the stone paving in front of the tall vermilion lacquered double gate at the end of the alley, the cardboard box in her arms, one step OUTSIDE the stone threshold; 小罗 (S7) stands half a step behind her LEFT shoulder; the black sedan stands behind them in the alley with 陆蔓 (S8) still inside it; the gate is shut except for a narrow gap of warm light.
[Shot 1] Medium: she lifts her head and looks up at the gate; a warm shaft of light lies along the gap between the two doors.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, close on the gap in the doorway: inside the compound, a young man's voice (S14) comes through the crack, casual and impatient, entirely unaware he can be heard: [Chinese] 姐，人到了没？……管他真的假的。能签字，就行。 陆航 (S14) stays completely off screen and is never seen in this beat.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.800, tight on 苏小满's (S1) face as she takes that in; her expression barely moves.
[Shot 4] At 00:09.800, hold on the warm light in the crack of the gate. 小罗 (S7) says nothing.
soundscape: An old alley at night: damp stone, a paper lantern creaking, and through the crack in the gate a young impatient male voice and a television somewhere deeper inside the house.
music: A low suspenseful string note under the voice from inside.

title: 门槛外
summary: Silent beat: one foot on the threshold, one hand on the cord, three seconds of not going in.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands one step OUTSIDE the stone threshold of the tall vermilion gate at the end of the night alley, the cardboard box in her arms; 小罗 (S7) stands half a step behind her LEFT shoulder; the gate is shut except for a narrow gap of warm light.
[Shot 1] Close on her feet on the paving: one shoe comes forward and stops with the toe exactly on the stone threshold, not past it.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.800, close on her left hand: it leaves the box, comes up to her collar and closes around the thin red cord, holding it tight.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.400, wide and held: the three seconds. The alley is completely still; the paper lantern glows; the girder of light in the doorway narrows as the wind moves the gate a centimetre.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, tight on her profile: her jaw sets, and she lets go of the cord. Nobody speaks in this beat.
soundscape: Damp night air, the lantern's paper creaking, a distant car, one long breath close to the mic.
music: A single sustained low string note that holds all three seconds.

title: 跨进去
summary: She is invited, she steps over the threshold repeating the words she overheard, and the gate closes. End of episode.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference image: 苏小满 (S1) stands at the stone threshold of the vermilion gate with the cardboard box in her arms, 小罗 (S7) half a step behind her LEFT shoulder, the gate shut except for a shaft of warm light.
[Shot 1] Medium: 小罗 (S7) steps around to the side of her and holds one hand out toward the opening, bending his head slightly, and says it in his quiet courteous Mandarin: [Chinese] 苏小姐，请。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, close on 苏小满's (S1) face: she does not look at him. She says it very quietly, almost under her breath, repeating what she heard through the gap, and it is the last line of the episode: [Chinese] ……能签字，就行。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, low angle on her feet: she lifts the box, grips it hard with both hands until the cardboard dimples, and steps up over the stone threshold and through into the compound.
[Shot 4] At 00:08.400, from outside, held: the two vermilion leaves of the gate swing slowly shut on their own weight and close with a soft heavy thud, taking the warm light with them; the empty alley, the lantern, and then nothing. Music out.
soundscape: One quiet courteous word, her own near-whisper, cardboard gripped hard, then the heavy soft thud of a lacquered gate closing and a long evening quiet after it.
music: A single struck gong, its tail ringing on into the dark. Episode end.
